quote:
Learning Dutch with Tim has been a genuinely great experience. He focuses on practical, everyday language that you can actually use, rather than just sticking to rigid textbook rules.

The lessons are super interactive and built around real conversations with classmates, plus he brings in lighthearted games that keep things fun. You learn something truly useful that sticks with you. I highly recommend working with Tim!
name: Yosra Sheriv
role: Localization Manager | ex-Vinted & Agoda | Product & Growth
